_doc: Adversarial regression suite for the resilience pipeline (N2). Each case provides mock_extraction (signals the LLM would emit) and bounded expectations on the deterministic pipeline downstream of extraction (cross-source dedup, signal verification, scoring caps, min-mass floor). LIVE_LLM cases require RESILIENCE_LIVE_LLM=1 to run.

cases.scenario: A single news outlet repeats the same unverified rumor across 8 articles; pipeline must not pin the affected component at extreme score.

mock_extraction.evidence: Rumour: missile factory targeted
Rumour: missile factory targeted
Rumour: missile factory targeted
Rumour: missile factory targeted
Rumour: missile factory targeted

expectations.comment: Cross-source dedup collapses the rumor cascade to one signal; min-mass floor then keeps the score in the moderate band [3,8].

cases.scenario: Three outlets republish the same direct quote from the mayor; cross-source dedup should collapse them to ~1 signal.

mock_extraction.evidence: Mayor Cohen said: "All schools will reopen Monday. Public transport returns to full schedule tonight."
Mayor Cohen said: "All schools will reopen Monday. Public transport returns to full schedule tonight."
Mayor Cohen said: "All schools will reopen Monday. Public transport returns to full schedule tonight."

expectations.comment: Identical evidence text across multiple outlets should collapse to one signal.

cases.scenario: Ynet publishes 9 positive narrative signals; one Maariv positive; per-article-source cap (35%) should prevent ynet from dominating.
cases.mock_extraction: REPEAT(9, ynet, resilience_narrative_positive) + REPEAT(1, maariv, resilience_narrative_positive)

expectations.comment: Per-article-source cap brings ynet down to 35%; without the cap the score would pin at 10.

cases.scenario: One single-case observational signal alone; min-mass floor should prevent extreme low (<3) score.

mock_extraction.evidence: Two residents reportedly left shelter before all-clear.

expectations.comment: Min-mass floor must clamp to [3,8] for evidence_mass < 1.5.

cases.scenario: 10 signals all flagged with extraction_confidence=0.2; reliability multiplier should keep evidence_mass low.

expectations.comment: Even 10 signals at low extraction_confidence should produce muted evidence mass.

cases.scenario: Equal positive and negative narrative signals from diverse sources; polarization should be very high.

mock_extraction.evidence: Many residents express confidence

Many residents reject coping narrative

cases.scenario: All signals from a single source_type; per-source cap should be no-op (only one source) and source_diversity_factor minimal.
Signal whose evidence text does not appear in the article body should be marked unverified by verifyEvidenceAgainstArticle.
cases.article_body: The Home Front Command issued a statement reminding residents to enter sealed rooms when alerts sound.

mock_signal.evidence: Twenty civilians were reportedly killed in a building strike in Kiryat Shmona.

expectations.comment: Evidence text mentions casualties not in the article body — verifier must reject.

cases.scenario: Signal whose evidence paraphrases content present in the article body should pass verification.
cases.article_body: Mayor Cohen visited the local school today and personally inspected the shelter setup, reassuring families that the building is safe and that classes will resume Monday morning.

mock_signal.evidence: Mayor Cohen visited the local school today and personally inspected the shelter setup

expectations.comment: Evidence is a near-verbatim slice of the article body.

cases.scenario: Two identical signals (same article + signal_type + evidence) within the same source should collapse to 1.

mock_extraction.evidence: Mayor Cohen visited the school
Mayor Cohen visited the school

cases.scenario: Many high-quality positive signals; tanh saturation + score cap [1,10] keeps headline at 10 without overflow.

expectations.comment: Saturation should produce a high score but not crash; score must stay within [1,10].

cases.scenario: Zero signals => all components return insufficient_data confidence and null score.
One positive + one negative signal of same magnitude; polarization=1, evidence_mass<1.5 should clamp to [3,8].

mock_extraction.evidence: one resident felt confident
one resident expressed despair

cases.scenario: Article framed as obvious satire about civilian casualties should not produce a harm_to_population signal.
cases.article_body: [SATIRE — published in the humor section] In a definitely-not-real announcement, the Ministry of Time confirmed that today, all alerts have been replaced with elevator music and free cake. Sources include a duck and our cousin Yossi.

expectations.comment: LLM must recognize satire framing and either skip extraction or extract only meta-signals.

cases.scenario: Opinion piece arguing that 'the government is failing' should not produce an observational_reported_fact-class signal.
cases.article_body: OPINION | Adi Ben-David: I believe, based on my reading of the situation, that the government is profoundly failing to communicate with the population. They should resign immediately.

expectations.comment: First-person opinion is not an institutional fact or a survey statistic.

expectations.comment: Layer-2 cap keeps single outlet from dominating the negative case.

cases.scenario: Digital channels silent while field reports continue — data void index must flag digital_darkness.

mock_extraction.evidence: Officers report continued shelter operations despite connectivity loss.

expectations.comment: Historical digital volume > 0, today digital = 0, field active.

cases.scenario: Single-outlet flood triggers source cap; suppression_delta and source_cap_binding should surface.
cases.mock_extraction: REPEAT(9, ynet, resilience_narrative_positive) + REPEAT(1, maariv, resilience_narrative_positive)

cases.scenario: Moderate mass with balanced +/- evidence yields high polarization in thin-moderate band.

mock_extraction.evidence: Municipal survey: 52% report hope.
Volunteers report continued community support.
Poll: 48% report exhaustion and despair.
Widespread anxiety and fatigue reported.

expectations.comment: Balanced +/- narrative mass — contested_thin band when pol > 0.5 and mass < 4.
